80' That looked a certain handball by Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
77' Williot Swedberg is substituted due to injury. Claudio Giraldez gives a chance to Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo).
77' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

70' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.

69' Excellent touch by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
68' 1 - 1 Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) receives a precise pass inside the box from Hugo Alvarez and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the right side of the net. 1:1.
68' Some great controlled play and passing from Celta Vigo. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
65' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
64' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
62' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Asier Villalibre walks off the pitch to be replaced by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao).
62' The game has come to an end for Adu Ares. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao).

49' Some neat passing and movement from Celta Vigo as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
